description: A single calm luminous eye enclosed inside a small hollow diamond-shaped rune. The eye means a mage inhabits a host. The outer diamond clearly separates the mark from a fire status icon. One isolated game UI badge, readable at 18 pixels. Refined crisp pixel art matching a warm medieval tactical game UI. Bronze outer shape, warm ivory inner light, three or four flat colors, strong simple silhouette and open negative spaces, no gradient glow. Transparent background, centered complete icon with 6 pixel margin. No lettering, no border panel, no background, no character, no flames, no burning sign.
